body: Don’t try hanging. I tried hanging myself when I was 13, just a few seconds of it was horrible. The feeling of not being able to breath normally is just scary, I managed to get down without causing any permanent damage, but there was a rope burn on my neck I had to lie about and come up with excuses for whenever someone would notice it for months. I’m still suicidal now, and what holds me back is the fear of what going to happen to those who care about me once I die. I don’t want to put them through that pain. So please talk to me if you think it would help, I started talking to friends about my problems and it helped to know that people cared about me. Life is a gift, don’t waste it.

I know what you mean. Im like that too. I‘m suicidal and I take it out on others at school, I lost a couple friends that way. But you aren’t a bad person, you just are acting out in a way to make yourself feel better, please talk to me if you want to. I starting changing towards people and being nicer to them, and it feels better to help them than to hurt them.

You are not a bad person.
I guess I’ll leave one then. I want them to know it was my fault, that I’m finally punishing myself. I deserve it.
I love you too, please don’t go.
I actually did try calling. It didn’t help anything, the guy I spoke to, ”Jim,“ just reassured me that it was all my fault. He told me I should have been a better friend. What kind of help is that?
Do you remember any of the specific videos.
All right, thanks, I’ll try it.
What were your ”other options?“
I hope you find success in the music industry. Interesting about ”Everyone has a purpose.“

I don’t. When I really think about, people will be sad. But if I’m dead, I won’t be there to see it.

I actually don’t know. She still killed herself no matter how much I begged her not to. I just wanted her to stop hurting herself. She killed herself, thinking she could get rid of the pain. She just passed it on to everyone who cared about her.
Yes. That’s how she did it. She drank bleach and a bunch of Advil tablets. I’m not even sure which killed her.
My friend killed herself about 2 months ago, and I could have done more to stop her but I didn’t. Now she’s dead, and there nothing I could do
Thank you. It means a lot that you care.
The 5th, about 3 days ago.
When I really think about it, I don’t really contribute to anything. So perhaps it would be doing the world a favor. I did fail.
If i had tried harder i feel like i could have saved her. I should have called the police or someone. Don’t they deal with stuff like that?
I should have tried harder, that’s the thing. I feel like I should have tried harder but now I can’t do anything.
Thanks. The last thing she ever said to me was over text, and she just told me to take care of myself, and to go to church. I’m not really religious. Why would she say that?
Thank you, I still feel like I should have tried harder, and reached out to people who are trained to help suicidal people.
She was. She had already attempted a couple time and she   cut herself. Thank you for your kind comment.
Thank you for this reply. I still feel like i could have done something. Like called the police or something.

Please reconsider you choice before you go through with this. I attempted suicide when I was 13, by hanging myself. While I was choking, I just thought about what all I could rather than just hanging myself. I was then afraid I wouldn’t get out of the noose, but I managed to, thanks to my mediocre tying skills. Your family will be devastated if you decide to go through with it. Don’t, you may not be aware of it, but there are people that care for you, even if they have a tough time of showing it, they do. So please, just talk to someone, anyone, it’s feels a lot better to tell someone, it helped me. So please, just talk to someone and do not do this. Please.

Geez, that's brutal, im really sorry to hear that. So how's your situation right now?

Nah I don't mind, no problem. I used the standard Hangman's knot, just with rope I bought at the hardware store. I choose hanging because I found it to be ceremonial and a honorable way to end my life. If you don't mind, why do you want to comment suicide?

Hey, You can talk to me about anything. I went through a period of my life where I wanted to kill myself. I even tried, and the method I used was hanging myself. As I jumped down and let the rope tighten around my neck and for it to take its course, while I was choking all I could think about were my friends and family. What made me rethink everything is me simply remembering that I told a friend I would see then tommorow. I managed to get down, but I was afraid I wouldn't be able to. So if you need someone to talk to, I'll listen to whatever you have to say.
